content: GitHub Pages serves a custom 404 from 404.html at the publishing-source root (docs). Next static export emits out/404.html so this works automatically. Directory index.html is served for trailing-slash URLs; with trailingSlash:true Next emits /movie/<slug>/index.html so deep links resolve without rewrites. Jekyll ignores _-prefixed dirs (_next) -> need public/.nojekyll (sibling repo already has it). Project sites inherit the account custom domain: patrickclery/dvd-seller Pages would appear at patrickclery.com/dvd-seller/ automatically; a project can override with its own CNAME subdomain.
